annotations.title: Review an owned photo for a picture edit

description: Free owner review of ONE ordinary Library image (kind=image) or one-off upload from this connected Soclo account. Select the Library row’s exact current owned HTTPS URL; Soclo checks ownership. Brand Kit items (kind=brand_asset) use soclo_brand_photo_reference. Pass the owned sourceUrl and a stable clientRequestId. A 202 preparing result can be polled with the same inputs. When ready, show the exact preview and if consentRequired is true ask for one tap to allow image edits and call soclo_photo_reference_confirm. Consent is saved once per account; people are allowed. This review is free and does not buy a picture. Preserve the owner’s photo order and obtain separate approval of the picture price before soclo_image_generate.

clientRequestId.description: Stable UUID for this exact upload and all preparing polls.

sourceUrl.description: Exact current owned HTTPS URL of a selected ordinary Library image or one-off upload. Not a Brand Kit asset.

name: soclo_photo_reference_prepare
